title: 1.2.25 Countdown with while
description: Write a while loop that counts down from 10 to 1, logging each value. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Set up the counter
steps.instructions: Create a variable called count and set it to 10.

steps.title: Write the while loop
steps.instructions: Write a while loop that keeps running as long as count is greater than 0. Inside the loop, log the current value of count, then decrease count by 1.
